answer: An agent's bond decays along a spiral schedule tied to its own history, so freshly minted identities start at the bottom of the curve. To claim paid work it must emit a plume of signed attestations from past counterparties; a cloned swarm can only cite itself, and that thin plume is rejected in validation. Payouts then route through a per-epoch cipher keyed to the reputation trail, so receipts cannot be replayed across wallets.
